build_cache_path: build the TFDS cache directory path, creating it if it does not exist
create_module_path: create the cached TFDS modules directory path and add it to sys.path
test_cache_path: test the cache_path function returns a valid epath.Path to the TFDS cache directory
summarize_module_path: summarize the module_path function that returns the cached modules directory and updates sys.path
review_default_cache_dir: review the _default_cache_dir function that determines the cache directory from environment variables
